The Drama Is ESCALATING In The NBA…
We had two absolutely insane endings… 
And Rudy Gobert put on a clinic! 
But we have to start in Portland where the Blazers and the Spurs put on a real playoff battle on Thanksgiving!
Both teams were trading heavy blows all night long, and neither could’ve pulled away from the other. So in the 4th, the intensity only ramped up…
Ciddy Sissoko throws down a poster jam on Wemby! That's French on French crime right there!
And one minute later, Dame decided to mess with the lanky giant as well.
Lillard was in his bag, hitting 5 - 3’s on his way to 29 points and 7 assists for the game. He gave the Blazers a 4 point cushion entering the 5 minute mark, but the Spurs had an answer…
Wemanyama tied the game with his 44th point of the night, 13 of which came in the final frame. 
And this stat absolutely blew my mind, Victor has 8 games with 40+ points and 15+ rebounds while the rest of the Spurs franchise have 8 combined as well. With legends like Duncan and Robinson I didn’t expect that… 
Anyway, Avdija drew the foul and knocked down both of his free throws on the other end to put Portland up by two. On the next play, Williams and Lillard double teamed Wemby which resulted in a costly turnover and a chance for them to hit the knockout. However, despite getting a pair of high quality looks, both Dame and Deni missed their 3 point shots, so the drama continues… 
After yet another impulsive possession by the Spurs, the Blazers were finally ready to light up the crowd. 
That was an elite punchline from the commentator about an equally elite player in Avdija!
Deni drained what turned out to be the dagger, finishing the game with 33 points, 12 boards and 7 assists on 5 of 8 shooting from downtown. 
The Blazers have now beaten 3 of the league’s best: the Lakers, Sixers, and Spurs.
And speaking of the Sixers, they faced the red-hot Miami team that won 7 games in a row, mostly thanks to these guys.  
Giannis with 32 points and 14 rebounds alongside Davion with 20 points and 10 assists led the Heat in this one, but none of that mattered when LeBron James took over. 
LeBron erupted for 14 of his 25 points in a span of 3 and a half minutes in the 2nd quarter. 
JB pulled his hamstring and didn’t return to action, but luckily for Philly, Maxey and VJ were flying up and down the court. 
VJ saves the loose ball on one end and then outruns everyone to catch the halfcourt lob on the other! Damn, he’s a velociraptor! Once they built a double digit lead early in the 2nd half, the Sixers never looked back. Edgecombe had 18 while Maxey racked up a team high 30 points in the comfortable win at the end. The Sixers snap Miami’s winning streak to go on a 15-4 record. 
In Charlotte, the Hornets and the Bulls gave us a heart stopping finish!
Brandon had himself a ball game last night scoring 35 points and putting his team up by 4 in the clutch. But the Bulls weren’t backing down…
Giddey caps off a crucial 9-2 run for Chicago, taking a 3 point lead with 90 seconds to go. 
Then, the Bulls thought they had it when Coby White missed the layup and Diabate was called for an offensive foul. But, coach Lee challenged the whistle and after the replay the refs overturned it to a pushing foul by Buzelis.
Speaking of that, now you can challenge the status quo and take matters into your own hands.
Moussa, who’s a career 65% free throw shooter, surprisingly knocked down both shots to cut the deficit to a single point. So with a minute to go, they desperately needed a stop. But…
Did you see that? Josh Giddey calls Buddy to come and set the 2nd screen for him just to get the switch on Coby White. And from that point on it’s barbecue chicken. 
White did his due diligence on the other end, hitting both free throws to keep it a tight race.
And despite getting pulled into a similar setting like the one before, he now stood his ground against Giddey who had nowhere to go… But then…

Oma's favoriete recept: Boemboe Kip 🥳

Oma's Indische kip met rijst en boontjes (Ajam Smoor)

Ingred
snippet.description:
Oma's favoriete recept: Boemboe Kip 🥳

Oma's Indische kip met rijst en boontjes (Ajam Smoor)

Ingrediënten (3 personen)
- 400 g kipfilet in blokjes
- 2 à 3 grote uien
- 2 el wokolie
- 1 bakje Conimex boemboe Ajam Smoor
- ½ pak Heinz Tomato Frito, of meer naar keuze
- 1 glas water
- 1 pot snijbonen
- 1½ kopje zilvervliesrijst
- 1 komkommer
- Gebakken uitjes
- Gembersiroop, alleen als het te zuur is

Bereiding:
- Leg de kip van tevoren uit de vriezer zodat hij ontdooid is. Laat de snijbonen uitlekken in een vergiet.
- Pel de uien en snijd ze grof. Verhit de wokolie in een ruime pan en bak de ui lekker aan.
- Schep het hele bakje boemboe erbij en bak het even mee. Voeg de kipblokjes toe en bak ze rondom goed door.
- Giet de Tomato Frito erbij en schep de snijbonen erdoor. Wordt het een dik papje, doe er dan een glas water bij.
- Strooi wat gebakken uitjes door de pan. Doe de deksel erop en laat het op laag vuur nog ongeveer 15 minuten doorwarmen.
- Kook intussen de rijst ongeveer 15 minuten in ruim water. Roer even door zodat hij niet aanzet en giet hem af in een vergiet.
- Snijd de komkommer met schil in plakjes.

Serveer de kip over de zilvervliesrijst, met de komkommer ernaast.

Tip van oma: je kunt het van tevoren maken en de volgende dag alleen opwarmen. Is het te zuur, blus dan af met een beetje gembersiroop.

snippet.title: Bharwa Tamatar With Just Us and Our Didi #home #didi #care #comfortfood #chulha #stuffed #tomato
snippet.description:
Every evening around sunset, Didi comes home, keeps her bag aside, and the first thing she asks during our random kitchen conversations is — “Dada, aaj kay khanar?” 🥹🪵✨

And the sweetest thing about her is… she never believes in making food just for the sake of it. She likes putting in that little extra effort. She likes feeding people in the most comforting, thoughtful way possible 🤍

Today I was craving Bharwa Tamatar and Bhakri, aur mann tha ki aaj khaana chulhe par bane 🥹 So while I was getting the chulha ready, I asked her, “Didi, aaj bharwa tamatar aur bhakri chulhe par bana do na?” 🪵🔥

That smell of firewood, the warmth around the chulha, our endless candid conversations while cooking together… these are the moments that make ordinary evenings feel so special 🌾🏡

So on today’s menu, chulhe par bane Bharwa Tamatar, garma-garam Bhakri aur saath mein thecha 🤍✨

This one feels like pure village nostalgia 🥹 Haath se bhakri ka ek tukda toda, usse thoda tamatar aur moongphali-khuskhus ka masala uthaya, aur saath mein zara sa thecha… that first bite 🤌🏻🔥

Honestly, some meals don’t just fill your stomach — they comfort your whole heart. So we thought, why not start sharing these simple, soulful recipes with you all too 🌼

Recipe 🍅

• Dry roast the peanuts, green chillies, garlic and khuskhus separately. Grind them together on a silbatta or in a mixer.
• Add red chilli powder, haldi, dhaniya powder, salt and a little oil. Mix well and set the masala aside.
• Finely chop an onion. Slit each tomato halfway down, keeping the base intact, and gently stuff it with the masala. Save the remaining masala for the gravy.
• Heat some oil in a handi, add jeera and let it crackle. Add the chopped onion and sauté till soft.
• Gently place the stuffed tomatoes in the handi. Add the remaining masala and a little water. Cover and cook slowly on the chulha or over a low flame on the stove till the tomatoes are tender.
• Serve hot with bhakri and thecha 🪵🔥🤍

snippet.title: Ternyata Air Kencing Bening Bukan yang Paling Sehat!! #informatif #faktaunik
snippet.description:
Panduan tujuh warna air kencing, dari yang paling perlu diwaspadai sampai yang paling sehat. Cokelat tua harus diperiksakan ke dokter. Merah juga perlu diperiksakan, kecuali muncul sesudah makan buah naga merah: pigmen merah buah naga bisa ikut keluar lewat air kencing tanpa ada darah, dan biasanya hilang dalam satu sampai dua hari. Oranye bisa berarti tubuh kurang minum atau pengaruh obat tertentu. Kuning tua tanda tubuh mulai kekurangan air. Kuning menyala sering muncul sesudah minum vitamin B dan tidak berbahaya. Bening bisa berarti minumnya sudah lebih dari yang dibutuhkan. Warna yang paling sehat adalah kuning pucat, tanda tubuh cukup minum.

Panduan ini bukan alat diagnosis. Bila warna aneh tidak hilang walau sudah cukup minum, atau disertai nyeri saat buang air kecil, demam, atau nyeri pinggang, periksakan ke dokter.

Sumber: MedlinePlus (National Library of Medicine), "Urine - abnormal color". Cleveland Clinic, "What Your Urine Color Means" (Adam Cohen, MD). NHS, "Dehydration". Healthdirect Australia, "Urine colour chart". Mayo Clinic, "Riboflavin (oral route)". Wiwanitkit V., "Pseudohematuria due to red dragon fruit ingestion", Chulalongkorn Medical Journal 51(3), 2007.

#informatif #faktaunik #kesehatan
